queries_run: CoreWeave regulation OR regulatory scrutiny AI cloud data center 2026
CoreWeave DOJ OR FTC OR EU competition 2026

findings.claim: 10-Q（期間 2026-06-30）風險因素稱 AI 與雲端服務產業因市場集中、反競爭行為等受監管機關日益審視；搜尋三輪未發現針對 CoreWeave 的 DOJ／FTC／EU 反壟斷調查。
findings.excerpt: AI and related industries, including cloud services, are under increasing scrutiny from regulators due to their concerns about market concentration, anti-competitive practices, environmental harm, misuse of AI

findings.claim: 10-Q 提及聯邦與州層級 AI 法規、跨轄區規則衝突，可能放慢客戶對平台的需求。
findings.excerpt: The difficulty of achieving compliance is exacerbated by conflicting regulations in different jurisdictions without a unified set of regulations.

findings.claim: Blockspace 報導：CEO Intrator 稱地方資料中心禁建令會改變建設地點而非減少需求；紐約州行政命令暫停大型新資料中心（≥50MW）部分環評核准最長一年。報導日期未能核實。
findings.source: Blockspace Media, 'CoreWeave shifts data center sites amid moratoriums'

regulatory_antitrust.note: 未找到 2026 年針對 CoreWeave 的反壟斷調查或拆分風險。Core Scientific 併購 HSR 等待期 2025-08-25 屆滿，交易於 2025-10-30 因股東票數不足終止。第三條 as_of 為估計（疑與 Q2 財報電話會議同期），日期未核實。有商業模板網站稱美歐調查 NVIDIA 優先配貨，無來源且未證實，不列入。
